scientific_question: Can the exact seven-trunk MLP family represent the dense 124M attention-only endpoint on its relevant residual-stream distribution, or is the calibrated endpoint/JVP deficit caused by representational under-capacity rather than the language-model optimization path?

theory.exact_layer_function: F_l(x) = diag(r_l) W_proj,g GELU(diag(p_l) W_fc,g x), where g is the contiguous depth group, W_fc,g and W_proj,g are shared, and p_l and r_l are positive layer-private diagonal gains
theory.singleton_handling: Layers 0-4 retain their exact dense-teacher MLPs because the seven-trunk topology does not constrain them.
theory.why_teacher_fit: The terminal common-gradient gate passed while calibrated endpoint and JVP recovery failed. Direct teacher fitting removes the LM trajectory and asks only whether the frozen function family can carry the endpoint.
theory.why_two_state_banks: Fit and holdout examples include both dense-teacher and compact-candidate residual-stream states so a result cannot be created by conditioning on only one trajectory.
theory.why_perturbations: Clean outputs constrain endpoint values; symmetric local input perturbations constrain the same input Jacobian without differentiating through a JVP objective.

fit_protocol.objective: mean layer-normalized clean-output MSE plus the mean layer-normalized symmetric-perturbation output MSE
fit_protocol.gain_parameterization: positive exp(log_gain), clipped after each step to log_gain in [-4, 4]
fit_protocol.restarts_per_group: one from the trained compact group plus one from each dense teacher layer in that group
fit_protocol.restart_selection: maximum held-out mean output explained target energy; input-JVP recovery breaks ties
fit_protocol.fit_scope: only the two constrained groups; no attention, embedding, normalization, residual, singleton MLP, or LM-head parameter changes

holdout_measurement.output_metric: explained target energy against the corresponding dense-teacher layer MLP
holdout_measurement.complete_model_splice: install the selected exact-family group functions into a clone of the dense teacher, retain exact dense singleton MLPs, and evaluate deterministic CE

frozen_gates.optimization_health: every restart must remain finite and the selected restart must reduce its normalized fit objective by at least 50 percent

classification.representational_pass: All output, JVP, CE, and optimization-health gates pass. The exact seven-trunk topology has endpoint capacity; the remaining failure is LM optimization/path acquisition.
classification.representational_fail: Optimization is healthy but any output, JVP, or CE gate fails. Reject the exact seven-trunk positive-diagonal sharing topology as an endpoint representation.
classification.optimization_inconclusive: The selected restart fails the 50 percent objective-reduction gate or becomes non-finite. Do not infer under-capacity; permit only optimizer-geometry diagnosis of this offline fit.
classification.mixed: Report every gate and use the ordered classification above; do not hide a CE failure behind a function-space average.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run exactly this offline teacher-forced representability ceiling after tests and a short runtime preflight.
not_allowed: hyperparameter sweeps outside the frozen restarts
authorization.next_if_pass: Study a causal acquisition rule for the same exact topology before any LM run.
authorization.next_if_fail: Use the fitted residual decomposition to derive one new compact function family; do not guess another trunk count.
